title: Zebra eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Stripes on body -->
  <path d='M40 44 Q42 58 40 72' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 42 Q52 58 50 74' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 44 Q62 58 60 72' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='70' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='61' y='70' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='33' y='70' width='6' height='4' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <rect x='61' y='70' width='6' height='4' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='32' y='84' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2a2a44'/>
  <rect x='60' y='84' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2a2a44'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M68 50 Q76 40 78 30 L86 32 Q82 44 74 54 Z' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Neck stripes -->
  <path d='M72 46 Q78 38 80 32' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 50 Q82 42 84 36' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='28' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(-15 84 28)'/>
  <!-- Head stripes -->
  <path d='M80 22 Q84 26 82 32' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M86 21 Q90 25 88 31' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='19' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(-20 78 19)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='19' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#c8a8c8' transform='rotate(-20 78 19)'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='93' cy='32' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#d8b8d8'/>
  <!-- Nostril -->
  <circle cx='95' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#6a4a7a'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='25' r='2.2' fill='#2a2a44'/>
  <circle cx='86.7' cy='24.4' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d='M74 20 Q70 26 72 32 Q68 34 70 40' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Snack (apple) being eaten near mouth -->
  <circle cx='96' cy='40' r='6' fill='#e84040'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ff8080'/>
  <path d='M96 34 Q97 30 100 31' stroke='#40c040' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Bite mark -->
  <circle cx='92' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M26 52 Q18 48 16 54' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='56' r='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
</svg>
